name: open_book_page_turning
prerequisites: Book must be positioned with spine on the left and pages accessible on the right.
Book must be stable and not sliding on the surface.
constraints: Avoid excessive force to prevent damage to the book pages.
Ensure the gripper does not obstruct the camera's view while turning the page.

explanations: The gripper moves to point 'aof' which is near the top right corner of the book for an optimal grip of the page.
The book's page is pulled parallel to the surface 'llk', with the normal vector suggesting the direction for pulling.
Low force is used to prevent tearing the page, and high precision ensures accurate gripping and turning of the page.
Slow speed is chosen to control the page turning carefully and avoid sudden movements.
